paragraphs.text: Facets of life, reflections of the soul.
"One timely cry of warning can save nine of surprise." —Sidar Jabari
The best use for a unicorn's horn is to adorn a unicorn. —Femeref adage
"My shield will bear a shining sun so you will always be with me. / Inlaid with gold, it will shine like glowing embers." —"Love Song of Night and Day"
To condemn the innocent you must first condemn yourself. —Civic Guild maxim
"Mangara is gone. Who among you doubts that I have taken his power?" —Kaervek
"There are harsher ways to learn the meaning of the word 'no.'" —Rashida Scalebane
"Suq'Ata believe in trade; Femeref, alms; Zhalfirins, steel. Be warned, Kaervek—now we are joined." —Sidar Jabari
"To the undiscerning eye, justice and vengeance can look the same." —Rashida Scalebane
"My goat was a small price to pay for the chance to see the hunting griffin dive and seize it." —Pashad ibn Asim, Suq'Ata trader
"I do not teach. I simply reveal." —Daudi, Femeref tutor
"If I have learned anything as a wizard it is this: never fight your own battles." —Waffa, sorcerer of Nyomba
"Faith is my shield, and hope is my armor; I am vulnerable only to myself." —Asmira, Holy Avenger
"I will return / with lizard skins for your sandals. Paint your eyes black and wait for me." —"Love Song of Night and Day"

"The days before the war were filled with strange portents: scouts and herders spoke of villages reduced to ash, of farmers taken from their fields, and of foul beasts roaming the plains in packs. I know, for I spoke to them all." —Hakim, Loreweaver
"The Femeref look only to the Sun for healing; they have never truly understood life's cycle." —Kifimbo, Shadow Guildmage
"A brilliant light can either illuminate or blind. How will you know which until you open your eyes?" —Asmira, Holy Avenger
"The fury in the lion's eye; the patience in the hippo's yawn; the pride within the griffin's cry are one within the iron tusk's stride." —"Iron Tusk," Femeref song
"Common soldiers can't understand what a sidar knows: the enemy can be a resource." —Sidar Jabari
Like a laughing knife, immaculate and sharp, is the Melesse.
"Unlike Zhalfir, the griffin needs no council to keep harmony among its parts." —Asmira, Holy Avenger
"All animals—even humans—can be herded. The trick is to make them think they choose their own destination." —Mangara
"Proud am I, / strong am I, / courageous in defending my children / and fierce in punishing what stands in my way." —"So the Elephant Speaks," Zhalfirin song
Discovered by Femeref mages, the Null Chamber is the ultimate testing ground for the uncreative.
For the first time in his life, Grakk felt a little warm and fuzzy inside.
"They knew Bantau was lost when, to hide the pearl he had found on the beach, he swallowed it—and soon grew wings." —Hakim, Loreweaver
It is not by the blood of dragons that Rashida measures victories, but by the sum of children who no longer wake from nightmares of scales and fire.
"Our soldiers are blessed with lizard scales as hard and cold as steel." —Sidar Jabari
"Do not go there, do not go / unless you rise on wings, unless you walk on hooves." —"Song to the Sun," Femeref song
Light creates shadow; light destroys shadow. Such is the transience of darkness.
"Prophecy is whatever one makes of it, but destiny cannot be changed." —Sidar Jabari
"A treasure to guard other treasures is worth the highest price." —Mtai, Civic Guildmage
"There is no sweeter music than the wails of a dying dragon." —Rashida Scalebane
"When we're aloft, I love to lean over the *Weatherlight*'s railing and watch the patterns the griffins' shadows make on the clouds below." —Sisay, Captain of the *Weatherlight*
The griffin's shadow gives courage to the righteous and dread to the idle.
Telim'Tor could no longer recall the exact number of assaults—but his troops could.
"Command is the act of balancing on a vine and convincing others that it is firm ground." —Sidar Jabari
"You returned a warrior. . . . Your hair was cut, your eye tattooed with the red triangle of war." —"Love Song of Night and Day"
"If the griffins tell of their gods, perhaps they speak of feathers bright as the Sun." —Afari, *Tales*
"Even the ancient storytellers proclaimed Zhalfir to be dominant over all Jamuraa. Kaervek's invasion shocked us all." —Hakim, Loreweaver
"A vizier's dish, best served drenched in honey and almonds." —Suq'Ata royal recipe
"Wear the falcon's feathers in your hair— be fast as the falcon, bright as the Sun." —"Rise on Wings," Zhalfirin song
A lie always returns; be careful how you catch it.

"Once, a Quirion asked why I was so cautious when the day was clear. I told him of the sky-blue hide of the cerluean wyvern, and he offered me double if I could conjure a strong tailwind!" —Sisay, Captain of the *Weatherlight*
"Useful . . . if you can find it." —Pashad ibn Asim, Suq'Ata trader
In front of every great wizard is a doomed apprentice.
"If you weren't born with it, you don't need it." —Grahilah, former trader of Amiqat
Dreams' riches are easily spent. —Suq'Ata adage
Not only the sleeping should fear dreams.
"Whoa—my tail will *never* fit through that hole!"
"Quick, Rhirhok—teach me to swim!" —Makht, goblin casualty
"One moment I was walking along the beach, and the next I was high in the air, staring into a hideous smiling face." —Tarub, Suq'Ata sailor
"There's nothing like a sudden shock to clarify one's thoughts." —Pashad ibn Asim, Suq'Ata trader
". . . pirates gambled with a djinn and lost the thing more dear than gold." —"Love Song of Night and Day"
"Shadimir was as surprised as he was relieved when the blow turned aside." —Afari, *Tales*
"The caliph was so intelligent he could not remember what he knew." —Azeworai, "Three Riddles"
"Turn your back for a second and they just vanish! As if they weren't shifty enough before." —Rhirhok, goblin archer
The sea leaves no room for tears. —Zhalfirin adage
Centuries ago, Mangara won the loyalty of the Quirion not by ruling their minds but by supporting their independence.
"Across the plains, farmers who braved the mists began to vanish. Most blamed the goblins; none guessed the truth." —Hakim, Loreweaver
"To the tutors, a 'poem of sand' was of little account, a 'poem of ivory,' priceless." —Afari, *Tales*
"Politics is a game—move a stone here, move a stone there—except sometimes the stones bleed." —Shauku, Endbringer
"Ahh! Opposable digits!"
"The memory of your existence will fade like the final stars of morning." —Kaervek
"Heel."
"Can you prepare for the unexpected? No, you cannot. You can prepare only to be surprised." —Teferi
"We've run aground sandbars before, but today, a sandbar ran aground us." —Kipkemboi, Kukemssa pirate
Shape this world in Zhalfir's image. —Shaper Guild maxim
To buy unseen land, pay in unseen coin. —Suq'Ata maxim
"Would you give up your hands to fly? That is what the birds have done." —*The One Thousand Questions*
"Comfortable even in a furnace? I've never met one who'd accept my wager." —Talibah, embermage
"Taniwha rolls in its sleep, and the land is awash with the waves." —Poetics of Hanan
"Stepping through time is like riding a camel. It may get you where you want to go, but the ride is rarely pleasant." —Teferi
"We threw dried fruit to the drakes that rode the air, streaming along the *Weatherlight'*s side as we sailed amidst the clouds." —Sisay, Captain of the *Weatherlight*
Made you look.
The first of the Thousand Deaths.
When mountains ride the sea, waves live upon the fields.
"What is taking them so long to fill the waterskins?" —Mwani, Mtenda goatherd
"Consider the wave: how weak the mother yet how strong the child." —Tywanna, Shaper Guildmage
Some smiles show cheer; some merely show teeth.
"What you call decay, I call ripening. You'll gain no sustenance from this harvest." —Kaervek
"The Mwonvuli Jungle has given the darkness teeth for tearing the gift of life from the weak." —Jolrael
A crash of rhinos in my head —Femeref expression meaning "a severe head pain"
"Only fools believe they will face my armies but once." —Kaervek
"As a child, I slept with a cloth over my face, to hide from the spirits that might pull the air from my lungs." —Mosi, Femeref weaver
Grieve for the soul in death dishonored. —Shadow Guild saying
King or herder, the maggots care not.
"The people wiped the sand from their eyes and cursed—and left the barren land to the hyenas and vipers." —Afari, *Tales*
"Femeref was guided by the wisdom of the Council of Voices. But in one terrible instant, they were slain, leaving Asmira as the sole voice of leadership." —Hakim, Loreweaver
"The ceremony ended with a voice from the shadows, a voice with vast, ominous power." —Kifimbo, Shadow Guildmage
"The foul entities of the Uuserk swamp had never before dared to spread their influence to the very heart of Zhalfir." —Hakim, Loreweaver
Whatever follows life is incurable. —Zhalfirin aphorism
"If it is weak, either kill it or ignore it. Anything else honors it." —Kaervek
"The night stalkers are such a minor power in Urborg. Their sad eagerness to elevate themselves makes them willing tools in the plundering of little Femeref." —Kaervek

"Of the six who went down the Uuserk Trail to scout ahead, one returned. She clawed at her eyes and nostrils and sobbed with horror. I was curious about what she saw, but we chose another path." —Scout Ekemet, final journal
"I no longer believe in a final resting place." —Shauku, Endbringer
"A zombie's bed must be a lumpy one or he wouldn't leave it so often." —Rana, Suq'Ata market fool
Embrace the Harbinger —Suq'Ata expression meaning "abandon hope"
"But I signed nothing!" —Taraneh, Suq'Ata mage
"If the curse does not strike you dead, question your soul." —Kaervek
"We realized the bog had not given up a soul but had come to claim a new one." —Scout Ekemet, final journal
"The finest offering of night is not stealth but daring." —Tetlok, Breathstealer
"It is terrible how one brief action can live forever in memory." —Jolrael
"In your final breath you still have something to offer Phyrexia." —Afari, *Tales*
Eternal life brings eternal hunger.
"I don't know what takes them; they die around me without time to scream." —Scout Ekemet, final journal
The rich's heirs often thank them after death . . . but preferably not in person. —Suq'Ata epigram
You lie down with rats, and the rats run away. —Suq'Ata insult
To keep the dead so others may live. —Shadow Guild maxim
Good help is hard to dig up.
"They exist only so long as the living take no notice." —Kifimbo, Shadow Guildmage
"Since I cannot stop death, I choose to stop life." —Kaervek
"The flesh is a casket for the soul." —Shauku, Endbringer
There are medicines for all afflictions but idleness. —Suq'Ata saying
"I shall make walls of their flesh, and their blood will be my mortar." —Kaervek
"Life for life: this is the immutable law." —Panya, Granger Guildmage
Zhalfir's destiny rings in tempered steel. —Armorer Guild maxim
"The trollish game of push-fall inspired this impressive tactic." —Sidar Jabari
"Tell me . . . have you ever sung the Song of Blood?" —Purraj of Urborg
I live without food, stand without leg, wound without force, and am harder to fight than to kill. What am I? —Femeref riddle
There is only so much a person may be buried with.
Even the lion envies the lark.
"Any day that I ride my horse up to my ankles in the remains of my enemies is a good day." —Akin, seasoned askari
"I dance the nothing dance, / Feet in the air, knives in the ground." —Femeref chant
"Dragonfire forged me a warrior." —Rashida Scalebane
"Fetch the pestridder, Paka—we've got dwarves in the rutabagas!" —Jamul, Femeref farmer
A dwarf's life belongs as much to the land as to the dwarf. —Creed of the Stonethrow Clan
"Big one I, One big eye. One-eye see Two-eye die!" —Traditional cyclops chant
A hefty price is no guarantee of quality merchandise.
Want all, lose all. —Zhalfirin aphorism
"Magic's only part of it, my friend. Diet does the rest." —Pashad ibn Asim, Suq'Ata trader
Storyteller: By my hand in the fire, this story is a tale of power. Listeners: May it give you strength.
"In the forest, fires light the sky as black clouds unfold their weight." —"Love Song of Night and Day"
They talk a good fight.
"Pathetic—like I wouldn't know a goblin painted up to look like a dwarf!" —Pashad ibn Asim, Suq'Ata trader
"I see a great victory and rivers of blood. And . . . hmm, looks like a spleen." —Grishnak, goblin soothsayer
"Can they *do* that?" —Imwita, Zhalfirin artificer, last words
"Never taunt an embermage, 'What are you going to do about it?'" —Akin, seasoned askari
The pulsing heat of the midday Sun burns in the Lion's eye. —Stone inscription, source unknown
"Inhale. Kill. Exhale."
When you've been chased by a dragon, you run from every lizard. —Suq'Ata saying
"Its burning power is more elusive than shade on the Unyaro Plains, more perilous than the horn of a rhino." —Akin, seasoned askari
Many mages have been consumed by their work.
"The Burning Isles are the home to a dozen lords who claim dominion. Jamuraa will look to only one leader: me." —Kaervek
When the other soldiers of Zhalfir fall, the askaris will yet stand.
"Blow, fiery wind, / strip illusion from the eye. / Blow, fiery wind of truth." —Femeref chant
"There are times solid ground gives precious little comfort." —Talibah, embermage
"What rainbow could possibly come of this rain?" —Asmira, Holy Avenger
"Air hot with sulfur. / Earth heaves beneath me. / Could it be the mountain / ate something bad?" —Dwarven mining song
Don't insult a Talruum unless your mount is swift. —Suq'Ata saying
"The curious merely amass knowledge. The ambitious use it." —Telim'Tor
"Execution awaits the dissenter." —Kasib ibn Naji, *Letters*
The mountain's voice shouts us all down.
"When traveling the Great Desert avoid wearing the scales of lizards, for the Viashino rule the sands and look poorly on the skinning of their cousins." —*Zhalfirin Guide to the Desert*
Speed and fire are always a deadly combination.
My thunder comes before the lightning; my lightning comes before the clouds; my rain dries all the land it touches. What am I? —Femeref riddle
"The efreet is a striding storm with a voice that crackles like fire." —Qhattib, Vizier of Amiqat
"Defiantly, the young cyclops popped the brushwagg into his mouth. His cheeks suddenly puffed, his eye bulged, and he was forced to agree with his elder." —Afari, *Tales*
"In the Mwonvuli you must divide your attention between what hangs overhead and what lies underfoot." —Sidar Jabari
Love is like a rhino, short-sighted and hasty; if it cannot find a way, it will make a way. —Femeref adage
Thus does nature assert herself.
"Tonight we'll eat a farewell feast. Cold corn porridge is not enough. / Let's peel papayas, pineapples, and mangoes, drink coconut milk, / and bake bananas." —"Love Song of Night and Day"
". . . and when the farmer awoke the next morning, all the seeds from his field were once again in their sacks." —Afari, *Tales*
"They say a Zhalfirin archer can split the eye of a griffin. Nonsense, of course: they have no faith to guide their darts." —Nuru, Femeref archer
"More armies have been lost in the confusion of the jungle mists than to any battle." —Jolrael
Five hundred years to grow—barely a minute to eat.
"I hate insects of every sort. The only mercy is that they are generally small." —Mwani, Mtenda goatherd
Hyenas laughing—what's the joke? —Femeref phrase meaning "that's not funny"
Leave no mouth agape, no stomach unfilled. —Granger Guild maxim
"What need have I for cavalry when I can have horse and rider both in one?" —Jolrael
Broad as a baobab—and about as smart.
"Be like the meerkat, my daughters: ever vigilant, true to your own, and wary of strangers." —Nabil Alamat, Suq'Ata merchant
Better a fierce thunderhead than a sky filled with locusts.
No two see the same Maro.
"The lion drank that lake right up! In thanks, he gave Siti the power to speak with lions and make them leave the goats alone." —Afari, *Tales*
"The few of us who survived were denied entry to our camp for two days—so like the pox were the marks we bore." —*Travelogue of Najat*
"I've never *heard* growth before." —Gowon, Femeref herder
"Death is not a debt I am yet willing to pay." —Purraj of Urborg
Better to fight the sand for a few hours than to sleep beneath it forever. —Suq'Ata truism
"I have hidden from the machinations of Zhalfir for centuries. Why should I join *your* campaign?" —Jolrael
"If magic is your crutch, cast it aside and learn to walk without it." —Teferi
In the Jamuraan jungles, there is often no separating beauty from danger.

"An ancient court mage unified the houses into guilds to serve Zhalfir above their own interests. Even during the civil war, the guilds stood together, a testament to the wisdom of Teferi." —Afari, *Tales*
"After the storm, I found a sea turtle dying on the sands, a blade of grass driven through its shell." —*Travelogue of Najat*
Victim of the two-toed faerie —Suq'Ata expression meaning "broken"
"To pass through the jungle: silence, courtesy, ferocity, as the occasion demands." —Kamau, "Proper Passage"
"Much can be learned from the bees about dying for a cause." —Asmira, Holy Avenger
"Enchant me with your tale-telling. Tell about Tree, Grass, River, and Wind. / Tell why Truth must fight with Falsehood, and why Truth will always win." —"Love Song of Night and Day"
The trees have ears, eyes, and teeth.
Sometimes the wise ones wove their magic into living plants; as the plant grew, so grew the magic.
"I will tell my father's stories . . . . How the elephants trampled the leopard cub, and its father, though he knew, killed nine goats instead." —"Love Song of Night and Day"
"Aselbo soon had the rhino eating from his palm and the snake waiting at his heels." —Afari, *Tales*
"Omens lie in this early harvest's fruit." —Asmira, Holy Avenger
"In all my years I've only met one mage who successfully trapped a djinn—and none who tried and failed." —Talibah, embermage
"It's filthy work, planting them." —Kifimbo, Shadow Guildmage
"Life is a resource that should belong only to the strong." —Shauku, Endbringer
The fire breathes while the air burns.
Life and death are two faces of the same coin.
"Hmmm—midnight snack."
"Our guardian levies a tax on all traders. Wise travelers pay with a minimum of fuss." —Qhattib, Vizier of Amiqat
Like some foul herdbeast, it grazes on the dead.
"The hazerider danced in the thunderstorm and sang to its music." —Afari, *Tales*
"You eat plants; I eat plants. You eat beasts; I eat you." —Drulvurg, troll king
"Only a gargoyle would take such delight in a thunderstorm." —Qhattib, Vizier of Amiqat
Only those who have nothing have nothing to fear.
"How ironic that the greatest forge of civilization is battle." —Mangara
"Her beauty was the beauty of the Sun at midday, deadly to those who underestimated her strength." —Azeworai, "Kenechi's Dream"
From you to me, so me to you. —Femeref children's taunt
"Sorry I burned down your village. Here's some gold."
In the eastern reaches of Jamuraa are arrangements of massive stones. No one knows their origins—for certain.
"Frozen, we watched the funnel pluck up three of the goats—pook! pook! pook!—before we ran for the wadi." —*Travelogue of Najat*
It's good to know more about your enemy's fate than your enemy does.
"My minions serve me in the light; I serve no one." —Shauku, Endbringer
Time is the one shackle you can't break. —Zhalfirin aphorism
"Like Day from Night, / I'll live my life apart from you, just glimpsing you across the sky, / because you cannot change, my dear, and nor can I." —"Love Song of Night and Day"
"Water is like breathing—necessary for life." —Asmira, Holy Avenger
Even wurms start out small.
Watching the windreaper —Zhalfirin phrase meaning "daydreaming"
"I'll capture gentle zebras / for your steeds and fill the stable with every kind of unicorn." —"Love Song of Night and Day"
Trade to trade, not to keep. —Suq'Ata motto
"The protection offered comes at a price. How numerous are your kin?" —Purraj of Urborg
"Sun follows Moon until she tires, then carries her until she's strong / and runs ahead of him again." —"Love Song of Night and Day"
"Once, a wealthy king commissioned an artificial creature to be crafted from the royal treasury, thinking it a clever ploy to have the jewels guard themselves." —Azeworai, "The Golem's Wish"
Pass me from soul to soul / soldier to herder, herder to beast, beast to soil / until I am everywhere. / Then pass me those souls. —Totem inscription (translated)
"Eternal life or your money back." —Unnamed Suq'Ata merchant, deceased
From jungle to sea, from sea to stone, from stone to field, from field to bone. What am I? —Zhalfirin riddle
Few are able to underestimate the hordes.
"The creature rose from the mountain, its body weeping fire." —Afari, *Tales*
Slow and heavy swings the club.
Held in the lion's eye —Zhalfirin saying meaning "caught in the moment of crisis"
"Let him be imprisoned while his possessions wander free." —Suq'Ata legal decree
It scattered falcons like a lion hunting among jackals.
A cage may keep you in, but it does not keep the stones out.
"The secrets of Phyrexia are expensive. You will pay in brass and bone, steel and sinew." —Kaervek
"Amazing thing, gravity. It seems to work every time." —Telim'Tor
"People laughed at my darts—once." —Telim'Tor
The three wizards knew only that this isle held a great mystery—and that patience alone would solve it.
